info.title: Simple API Mode
info.description: A simple API, no auth protection so you can add and delete what you want in a multi-user mode.

get.summary: return all the instances of item
get.description: return all the instances of item

parameters.name: _sortBy
parameters.description: Sort collection results by a field. Use +field or field for ascending order, and -field for descending order. Multiple fields can be combined with commas, e.g. +field,-other.

id.description: Field is an ID and should not be amended or set.

type.description: Value must be an Enum (cd, dvd, book, blu-ray) value. Value is mandatory.

isbn13.description: Value is mandatory. Value must match the regex [0-9]{3}[-]?[0-9]{1}[-]?[0-9]{2}[-]?[0-9]{6}[-]?[0-9]{1}. Maximum length allowed is 17.

price.description: Value must be a Float of min 0.000000 and max 50000.000000. Value is mandatory.

numberinstock.description: Value must be an Integer of min 0 and max 100.
